rows.title: Ade Okonkwo
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Said yes. Sleeves pinned. A man in a ripped cardigan and scrub trousers, both sleeves quilled to each other across his chest, glasses askew.

rows.title: Auntie Tamarind
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Mandrill. Runs the market. An old grey-bearded mandrill in a string of pearls and a silk dressing gown, sitting on a bamboo platform high in the jungle canopy, a jeweller's loupe in one eye.

rows.title: Big Tom Okafor
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Gentle giant. A gentle giant of a man with huge shoulders and a kind smile, holding a sledgehammer lightly in one hand, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Biscuit Bill
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Volunteer. Regretting it. An adult gingerbread man in a paper bow tie strapped to a giant revolving dinner plate, one ear chipped away, crumbs beneath his boots.

rows.title: Button
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Truffle pig on a leather lead. A small pink pig with muddy knees and a leather harness, its snout buried in white mushroom dust beside a steel trolley under cave work lights.

rows.title: Calloway Pruett
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The Buyer. Acquisitions. A slim man in a spotless white suit and white gloves, holding a white clipboard, standing very straight in a roped-off VIP box above a jungle cooking stadium.

rows.title: Camille Cho
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Holds the ring light. A woman in a venue-staff polo and track pants, both hands on a scuffed ring light, the cable wrapped around one wrist, standing one step below a woman in a pageant sash.

rows.title: Chanterelle
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Mushroom sommelier. A tall slender mushroom-person with a frilled orange cap and gills, wearing a tiny velvet waistcoat, holding a silver tasting spoon.

rows.title: Chef Barnaby Crumb
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: TV chef. The Apprentice. Warm. A soft, pink, smiling man in his fifties in spotless chef's whites and a tall paper hat, half-moon glasses on a chain, a wooden spoon in one hand.

rows.title: Chef de Partie Olu
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The Librarian. A former crawler. An adult man half normal height in an oversized white chef apron, bandaged arms, crumbs on his shoulders and a bee on his collar.

rows.title: Chef Ignatius Vell
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Head judge. The Master. Cold. A tall, very old man in a black chef's jacket buttoned to the throat, white hair swept back, a silver tasting spoon in one hand and a bitten red pepper in the other.

rows.title: Cinder
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Rottweiler. Holds. A wet black rottweiler sitting square on a jungle path, scarred muzzle, a gold hoop for a tag, eyes on a woman's hand.

rows.title: Clove
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Runner. Lost the caravan. A skinny young runner in a torn catering-company polo and a headset with no battery, sitting on a burst sack of spices in a gingerbread street.

rows.title: Crackling
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Gingerbread pig handler. An adult gingerbread woman with white icing eyebrows and a waxed apron, sitting in an open biscuit tin on a steel trolley.

rows.title: Daniel Bautista
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Dependable. A solid steady man in a worn work vest with a calm focused expression, tools at his belt, arms crossed, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Dmitri Volkov
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Patient hunter. A lean patient man in a weathered coat with a small notebook in one hand and a rifle slung over his shoulder, watching from cover, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Dolly Fenn
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Beekeeper. Stuck. An adult woman in a scuffed white beekeeper's suit, veil pushed back, hands raised slowly, both boots glued to a wall of wax cells by drying amber.

rows.title: Doughty the Baker
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Baker. The accuser. A broad gingerbread baker in a floury apron and a squashed white hat, red-eyed and furious, holding a gingerbread-man cookie cutter up like a badge in front of a crowd…

rows.title: Dry Jack
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Groundskeeper. Very thirsty. A shrivelled adult groundskeeper in a sun-bleached hi-vis vest, cracked rubber boots, a coiled hose over one shoulder and a cattle prod.

rows.title: Elle McGibbons
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Crowd favorite. A radiant woman in a sequined jacket waving to a cheering crowd, big confident grin, one fist raised, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Florin
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Old, still counting. A grey-haired man in a stitched flak jacket and kitchen clogs, sword oiled, notebook in the off hand, standing where the floodlight misses.

rows.title: Frank Q
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Shooter. A tall quiet man in a long coat holding a revolver steadily with one hand, calm half-smile, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Grandpa Rusk
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Pensioner. Selling himself. A very old, very dry gingerbread man on a sunny bench, his piping faded to grey, a tray of his own crumbs on his knees.

rows.title: Greta
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Streamer. Gretel. A round-faced young woman in a matching hoodie with her phone held up, mascara run, a half-eaten cream bun in her other hand, inside a giant gilded birdcage.

rows.title: Gwendolyn Duet
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Wants the watch. A woman in a scorched pageant sash and one heel, the other foot bare, smiling into a ring light held by another woman on the Stadium stairs.

rows.title: Hans
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Streamer. Hansel. A plump young man in a too-tight hoodie with a ring light clipped to it, cheeks shiny with icing, grinning at a camera drone from inside a giant gilded birdcage.

rows.title: Hekla
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Shield. Short count. A tall woman in a scavenged riot vest over a wool jumper, round shield scarred white, spear taped at the grip.

rows.title: Hive Guards
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The door staff. A line of terrier-sized honeybees standing shoulder to shoulder across a glowing amber wax wall inside a hollow tree, stingers lowered, antennae up.

rows.title: Jonah Hale
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Collared. On her word. A broad man in a hotel bathrobe belted with a bike cable, a thin sponsor collar buckled at the throat, hands wrapped.

rows.title: Jungle Hornets
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Raiders. Here for the grubs. Dog-sized yellow-and-black hornets forcing their way through a chewed hole in a wall of white honeycomb cells, mandibles open, daylight behind them.

rows.title: Katia Grim
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Adaptable. A determined woman with short hair and a scarred jaw standing in a battered crawler's kit, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Kenji "Two-Tap" Mori
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Two-Tap. A precise lean man in a sleek dark jacket with two fingers lifted in a measured gesture, a compact pistol in his other hand, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Krakaren Spawn
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: A white squid the size of a dog flopping across a wet shingle beach in a wrecked cave film set, a dozen more just like it behind.

rows.title: Lady Glacé, the Jam Golem
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: A hot rolling doughnut.

rows.title: Li Jun
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Fast, and angry. A young man in a cook's apron over running kit, two knives reversed in his fists, already halfway through a step.

rows.title: Li Na
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Quiet, then not. A young woman in the same running kit, apron strings tied like a sash, barefoot, one palm open and one fist closed, standing very still at the end of the bridge.

rows.title: Lucia Mar
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Two rottweilers. An adult woman in a mud-streaked tracksuit and one gold hoop, one rottweiler sitting square at her knee and another already on the path behind the party.

rows.title: Madame Sabatier
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Knife-thrower. Rival chef. An adult knife-thrower in a sequinned chef's jacket with a bandolier of cleavers across her chest, hair scraped up under a toque.

rows.title: Maggie My
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Talker. A sharp-eyed woman with a wide smirk leaning on a table, one hand mid-gesture as if mid-argument, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Mayor Snap
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The Mayor. Crumbling. An elderly gingerbread woman in a wheelbarrow wearing a gold chain of office, her brown glaze crazed all over like an old plate, one arm hanging by a thread of icing.

rows.title: Miss Hem
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Wardrobe mistress. An adult woman in a black slip and a tailor's apron, tape measure around her neck, a red remote in the pocket.

rows.title: Miss Quill
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Asks, then quills. A woman in a pencil skirt and a torn lab coat, porcupine quills bristling through the cloth at her wrists, glasses mended with tape, one hand on a plastic chair.

rows.title: Mordecai
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Rat guildmaster. Fake caveman. A bearded rat-man a head shorter than a human, tired eyes, a leopard-print fur tunic over a threadbare vest, a foam club across his knees.

rows.title: Mother Treacle
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The Witch. Keeps the oven. A tall, thin old witch of dark treacle-glazed gingerbread with boiled-sweet eyes and long sugar-glass nails, a black iron peel in one hand.

rows.title: Ochre
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Painter. The eldest. An old woman in a hide cloak, heavy-browed, hands stained red ochre to the wrist, a chewed-stick brush behind one ear.

rows.title: Old Cured Hide
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Smoked bear-thing. Boss. A huge bear-shaped thing of black smoked hide and leather-hard muscle, cracked like old jerky, curls of smoke rising from its nostrils.

rows.title: Pearl Eight-Mitts
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: An octopus on dish duty. A large grey octopus standing in a shallow steel wash trough, eight yellow rubber gloves, a grease-spotted apron and a telephone tucked beneath one arm.

rows.title: Penny
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Coin stall. Tamarind's youngest. A small capuchin monkey in a bellhop's cap two sizes too big and a waistcoat sewn with bottle caps, biting a gold coin behind a bamboo counter of clubs, spears.

rows.title: Pilar Reyes
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Fills the gap for Jun. A stocky woman in a lifeguard hoodie and pool shoes, a cooler lid strapped to one forearm with a bike inner tube, planted sideways on wet bridge planks.

rows.title: Pip
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Runner. Terrified. A skinny teenager in a RUNNER lanyard and oversized headphones, holding a boom pole far too long for him, flinching away from black water in a lamp-lit cave.

rows.title: Plodder
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Herd beast. Walking dinner. A grey grazing beast the size of a minibus, armoured plates down its back, a toothless beak full of ferns, mild eyes, a small calf pressed against its leg.

rows.title: Prepotente
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Goat. Too loud. A white goat in a child's backpack worn backwards, straps chewing his chest, mouth open mid-scream on a steel walkway above the canopy.

rows.title: Quan Ch
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. One clean hit. A lean man in a black tee and wrapped hands, one kitchen knife held low, two fingers already on the spine of the blade, floodlight cutting his shadow in half.

rows.title: Queen Mellifera
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Queen of the hive. Boss. A honeybee the size of a horse on a throne of dark old comb, a BEST IN SHOW rosette pinned to her thorax, a hundred workers grooming her.

rows.title: Raptor
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The pack. A lean grey raptor the size of a man, crouched in ferns under a floodlight, head cocked, a crew lanyard caught on its claw.

rows.title: Ren Ibarra
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Paid. Crossbow on the exit. A young man in a delivery jacket and one gardening glove, crossbow braced on a railing at the edge of the floodlight, one foot already turned toward the dark.

rows.title: Rosa "Chainsaw" Delgado
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Barricade breaker. A grinning muscular woman in a welding apron holding a roaring chainsaw, sparks flying, a smashed barricade behind her, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Rosa Quint
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Florist. Upside down. An adult florist in a green apron hanging upside down in strangler vines over a jungle sinkhole, hair hanging down, arms folded, an empty secateurs holster on her belt.

rows.title: Saffron Wilde
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The Showrunner. The Rebel. A lean, sunburnt woman in her forties in a khaki shirt with the sleeves torn off, a bandana, a survival knife on her belt and a frying pan in her hand.

rows.title: Signet
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Asks for a kneel. A woman in a thrift-store coat with a royal crest picked out in thread, throat bare, a thin sponsor collar coiled in one palm.

rows.title: Sigrun
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Last of the count. A woman in a torn high-vis vest over a thermal, one boot off, ankle bound in a ripped sleeve, standing in a doorway with a length of pipe and her weight on the good leg.

rows.title: Sir Wobble, the Butterscotch Golem
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: A towering amber wobble. A translucent amber jelly giant in a steel freezer pen, spoons and a sealed gold tin suspended in its belly.

rows.title: Sister Agnes Mbeki
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crawler. Merciful until not. A calm older woman in a plain grey habit with a heavy iron-bound staff and a kind but unyielding gaze, bright cartoon style, no text.

rows.title: Soot
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Rottweiler. On the exit. A brindle rottweiler standing side-on in a gap between trees, collar chewed white, weight already toward the dark behind him.

rows.title: Tess
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Runner. Hiding. A small young woman in a RUNNER lanyard and a filthy crew fleece, curled up in the tail of a crashed helicopter, clutching a dead walkie.

rows.title: The Alpha
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Raptor matriarch. Boss. A huge scarred raptor matriarch, twice the size of the others, feathered grey and rust, stepping out of the ferns into floodlight beside a crashed helicopter.

rows.title: The Brinejaw
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Crocodile. Wearing a bib. A bus-sized crocodile with pale salt crusting its armoured back, a filthy catering bib tied beneath its throat and a small hoofed carcass between its jaws.

rows.title: The Garlic Breadwinner
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: A smoking, crust-armoured loaf.

rows.title: The Giant Snail
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Roaming dinner. Very slow. A shell the size of a car, wet brown and barnacled, blocking a jungle trail, a slime trail you could skate on.

rows.title: The Gourd Mother
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Strangler plant. Boss. A towering knot of dark green strangler vines rooted in the floor of a jungle sinkhole, a vast swollen orange gourd for a heart.

rows.title: The Great White Krakaren
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: A huge pale squid-thing, blind and milk-white, rising out of black water in a wrecked film set in a cave, tentacles wrapped round a lighting stand.

rows.title: The Hearth Clan
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Hunters. The first cooks. Eight broad, heavy-browed adults in hides and red ochre paint crouched round a fire under a limestone overhang, fire-hardened spears across their knees, mouths full.

rows.title: The Pickpocket Troop
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Market monkeys. Thieves. A dozen capuchin monkeys in tiny waistcoats, some drunk, swinging between rope bridges high in the jungle canopy, one running off with a raw steak.

rows.title: The Sommelier
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: The Library attendant. A blind pale creature in a velvet waistcoat behind a steel museum desk, four polished tasting spoons in its pocket and a brass bell under one hand.

rows.title: The Subzero Bull
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: A frost-caked minotaur. A massive white-rimed minotaur in a steel freezer pen, ice hanging from its horns and a plume of frost pouring from its nostrils.

rows.title: The Truffle Sow
rows.subtitle: Floor 2
rows.blurb: Giant mushroom-crusted sow. A sow the size of a delivery van in a limestone cave, fungal plates covering her eyes, pale tusks lowered over a straight furrow between yellow puffballs.
